title: Shared interview session wire shapes kept only in memory
description: Presence never reaches state.json. `heartbeat` is the POST /api/heartbeat body: `visible` is the Page Visibility state, `lastInput` the seconds since the person's last key, pointer or touch, `lastFocus` the seconds since the tab last gained focus or was shown (the person's question and typing come from a visible live tab before a hidden one, and within each the one with the most recent lastFocus; `focusId` changes with each focus or show, and the server places a tab's focus in time again only when it changes, so a late beat never moves an unchanged focus later), and `away` is true while the person's own Away (the snooze) lasts; the page drops it on their next input. `tab` names the browser tab that beats, so each of a person's tabs and devices keeps its own presence: the person is active while any live tab is visible with recent input and not snoozed, and away only when every live tab is hidden, idle or snoozed. `presence` is one entry of the snapshot's `presence` list: `active`, or `away` with `since`, the server time the person went away. Someone with no heartbeat for 90 s is offline and absent from the list; the snapshot's `lastSeen` maps each offline person the server still remembers (memory only, so not across a restart) to the server time of their last heartbeat. `presenceOnly` is what GET /api/state answers when the poll's ETag differs from the current one only in presence or the 5-second clock tick: the snapshot's `serverTime`, `presence` and `lastSeen` with its unchanged `rev`; the page keeps the rest of its last snapshot. `chatPage` is the GET /api/chat answer, `ok` true as every success answers: messages as the snapshot reads them, oldest first, with `before`, its oldest message's id, while older ones exist.

files.description: What the page's messages carry, read as the snapshot's `files`; left out when they carry none.
